report.jobInShort: MSCI is hiring a Project Manager in Hong Kong for its Total Plan Onboarding team, to run client investment-data onboarding projects on its platform. The role is about keeping projects on track, communicating status to clients and internal teams, defining scope and deliverables with stakeholders, and flagging risks early. It wants solid project-management and finance-industry grounding plus the ability to juggle several projects at once.
